title: Beans & Rats
subtitle: A VR alchemy game where the player crafts potions by following recipe steps: pouring ingredients, stirring, and controlling the fire to achieve the correct color and effect.
overview: Beans & Rats is a VR potion-crafting experience focused on tactile, step-by-step interaction. The player takes the role of an alchemist and prepares mixtures based on recipes stored in a magical book. Gameplay revolves around performing the correct sequence: pouring ingredients, stirring, and managing the heat under the cauldron to reach the expected potion color and outcome. The project emphasizes readable feedback (visual, audio, and VFX) and a clear learning curve through guided recipes.
role: I built the core gameplay logic: player movement and interactions, and the main cauldron system responsible for processing recipes and validating potion correctness. I implemented a dynamic liquid pouring system designed for VR readability and responsiveness. I created a page-flip shader in Shader Graph for the interactive recipe book, and integrated sound using FMOD to reinforce every step of the crafting process. Additionally, I prepared VFX, post-processing, and designed the level layout to support smooth player flow and clear visual focus.
description: A VR alchemy crafting project where the player follows a magical recipe book to pour, stir, and control heat to create correct potions.
